semantics.delay: Extra queue delay in policy decisions; default 0 for all seven checkpoint configurations.
semantics.act_every: Number of game frames between policy inference calls. Each chosen ActionChain may contain a sequence of different controller commands, so not necessarily repetition of one command.
semantics.runtime_qualification: These are upstream release defaults. Benchmark screenshots and user description identify zero added delay, but do not supply a launcher configuration proving retention of every upstream decision interval.
